principles: Every upgrade publishes exact execution/consensus/config hashes.
Activation occurs at a declared epoch boundary.
Protocol upgrades require frozen governance/readiness rules.
Testnet emergency patches must preserve finalized history.
Client version compatibility windows are published before activation.

emergency_upgrade.authority: Decision 14 Emergency Council + >=2/3 Validator House as applicable
emergency_upgrade.cannot: rewrite finalized history, mint arbitrary funds, reduce historical slashing evidence
